semantics.precision_scope: The official statewide 9-1-1 address point for the exact site address named by state registry records for the IP Meitner data center. It locates the campus address, not a data hall, phase, parcel boundary, footprint or current work extent. Source value rounded to seven decimals.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: TxGIO states that each authoritative 9-1-1 source applies its own point-placement guideline and policy and publishes no positional accuracy for individual points.
